title: phyteuma orbiculare var. ellipticum
intro: Phyteuma orbiculare var. ellipticum, commonly known as Alpine Phyteuma, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It is primarily used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyteuma orbiculare var. ellipticum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
